diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references
null_resource.wait_for_cluster already depends on aws_eks_cluster.this through the ENDPOINT reference in its provisioner environment; its explicit cluster depends_on duplicates that ordering.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch nodes before workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy is attached. Order instance launch after this attachment so bootstrap has EKS worker permissions.

aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch nodes before workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy is attached. When this attachment is enabled, ensure it precedes worker launch so the CNI has its required permissions.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch nodes before workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly is attached, racing image pulls during bootstrap. Wait for the attachment before launching workers.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch nodes before workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy is attached. Wait for this attachment so bootstrap has EKS worker permissions.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch nodes before workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly is attached, racing bootstrap image pulls. Order launch after this attachment.

aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch nodes before workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy is attached. When enabled, this attachment should precede worker launch so the CNI has its required permissions.

aws_autoscaling_group.workers can start bootstrapping nodes before kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth authorizes their roles. When aws-auth is managed here, order worker launch after the ConfigMap to avoid a node-registration race.
